description: WHM Jupiter interface customization selection and deletion. The pinned retrieval response contains no declared data contract; update serialization remains excluded.

notes.text: Available in cPanel and WHM 100 and later. Deletes customization data for the Jupiter theme only. Server owners and resellers can customize their users interface. application is cpanel or webmail. Omitted path deletes the customization data; a supplied path removes only the selected element using the supported dot-separated JSONPath subset. Deletion changes branding and has no client rollback. The source response declares metadata only, so the typed method returns void.
Client policy: send one request without automatic retry or rollback. Optional null arguments are omitted; accepted explicit zero and empty strings retain their supplied values.
